changes: Story dailies can now look back: after each card you read the story behind that card, and the start card has its own little story on the start screen.
At the end of such a story the results screen shows every card in the right order with its story, so the whole tale comes together. Older stories still look as before.
test: Nothing to try on your phone yet: the first story in the new style is the Lautrec draft for Tue 24 Nov. Once you approve it, play it and look at the end screen.
